pairs.difference: Both whistles are smooth orange plastic, so the evidence is thin. A has an even satin body, a soft highlight along the top edge, a small raised lip around the window and a darker, more neutral steel ring. B has the same plastic but looks more lit from within: the window cavity is hot, saturated red, the mouth interior glows red, and the edge highlights are soft and hazy.
pairs.fix: Satin molded orange plastic with a low, even sheen. Keep the inside of the window a dull dark orange-brown shadow, not glowing red. Add one thin crisp highlight along the top edge. Make the ring dull grey steel.

pairs.difference: A's cord is matte and finely braided, with small repeated strands along the wrap, and the tassels split into thin fibres, so it reads as fabric against the polished brass. In B the rope is three fat, glossy red twists and the tassels are smooth inflated lobes with shiny highlights. Cord and brass share one lacquered finish, like balloon or plastic.
pairs.fix: Thin matte woven cord made of many fine braided strands, with no shine. Tassels are bundles of thin loose threads with frayed ends. Only the brass is polished; the fabric stays dull.

pairs.difference: A's flower and leaves are raised, puffy, glossy shapes stuck onto the cup, and the rim is a fat shiny blue tube, so the whole cup reads as vinyl toy. In B the flower is a flat painted decal on the glaze with thin leaf stems, soft-edged blue bands sit in the surface, and the white ceramic has a soft, quiet sheen.
pairs.fix: White glazed porcelain with a soft sheen. The flower is a flat hand-painted decoration lying in the glaze, with thin stems and no relief. The rim is a thin painted blue line, not a raised tube.

pairs.difference: A's apples have skin: fine yellow streaks and speckles, a green-yellow blush around the stem dimple, and thin woody stems, while the cloth lies soft and matte. B's apples are uniform glossy red with hard white window highlights and no skin marking, so they read as candy or plastic. The leaves are equally shiny, the cloth has a clean printed sheen, and the wicker strips are thick and smooth.
pairs.fix: Apple skin with fine vertical streaks and small pale speckles, a yellow-green blush near the stem, and a soft broad highlight. Thin brown stems. Matte cotton cloth. Thinner wicker strips with a dry surface.

pairs.difference: A's staves are saturated orange with a varnished look and large decorative swirl grain. Big round rivets, each with its own hot highlight, repeat along every hoop, and the top stave ends are chunky blocks, so details are enlarged and toy-like. B has drier, browner wood with fine thin scratch-like grain lines, slim plain steel hoops with a brushed sheen and no oversized hardware.
pairs.fix: Dry, lightly worn brown oak staves with thin, quiet grain lines. Slim dull iron hoops with a soft brushed sheen and no large rivets, or only tiny ones. The wood stays matte and only the metal catches light.

pairs.difference: A's body paint is a soft satin with broad, low highlights. Trim is thin, muted grey, glass is pale and low contrast with fine wipers, and the rubber tyres are matte. B lacquers everything: mirror-like yellow paint, thick liquid chrome on the bumper, grille and mirror, saturated blue glass with glossy blobs, and chunky trim, so paint, chrome and glass all share one high shine.
pairs.fix: Soft satin yellow car paint with broad, gentle highlights. Thin muted metal trim, not liquid chrome. Pale slightly hazy glass. Matte black rubber tyres. Keep the grille and bumper slim.

pairs.difference: A's tent is a matte canvas with soft fold shading, a thin stitched-looking hem and rolled edges at the door, with thin guy lines, so it reads as heavy cloth. B's cloth is saturated and slightly waxy with smooth, painted-looking sheen bands, and it carries enlarged decorative details: fat orange toggle patches with brass buttons, thick cartoon rope and shiny pegs.
pairs.fix: Plain matte canvas with soft fold shadows and a thin sewn hem. Use small, simple tie-backs and thin guy lines. No big buttons or thick decorative rope, and no sheen on the cloth.

pairs.difference: A's pot has a dull, grey cast-iron surface with fine speckled soot and pitting toward the base, a thin bright metal rim and a flat, simple soup surface. It reads as metal, though the speckle is slightly noisy. B's pot is smooth, polished blue-grey with a soft glossy band and no wear, rim and bracket equally sleek. The stew is packed with shiny glazed chunks, and logs and stones have the same waxy polish.
pairs.fix: Dull black cast iron with a rough, lightly pitted surface and soot around the base, with only a faint sheen near the rim. Matte stones and dry bark on the logs. Fewer, less glossy pieces in the stew.

pattern: Generated cards still apply one lacquered, candy-gloss finish to every material, so cloth, rope, fruit, wood, paint and metal all share the same soft shiny highlights and saturated glow. Fine surface marks such as thread strands, skin speckle, quiet grain and wear are smoothed away. In their place come enlarged toy details: puffy embossed decoration, fat rope and tassels, big rivets, thick chrome. Real cards keep a mix of matte and shiny within one object, with small, thin, quiet details.
